description: Source code implementing in-memory hash table with operations like insert, delete, replace, find, and resize, including hash functions and internal management functions.

methods.name: dictCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new hash table.

methods.name: dictExpand
methods.description: Expands or creates the hash table with a specified size.

methods.name: dictAdd
methods.description: Adds a new key-value pair to the hash table.

methods.name: dictReplace
methods.description: Replaces the value for an existing key or adds a new key-value pair.

methods.name: dictDelete
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the hash table.

methods.name: _dictClear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the hash table.

methods.name: dictRelease
methods.description: Releases memory associated with the hash table.

methods.name: dictGetIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for the hash table.

methods.name: dictNext
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next entry.

methods.name: _dictExpandIfNeeded
methods.description: Expands the hash table if needed.

methods.name: _dictNextPower
methods.description: Calculates the next power of two for a given size.

methods.name: _dictKeyIndex
methods.description: Finds an index for a new key or returns -1 if key exists.
